summary: Savers Value Village, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a secondary offering of 20,000,000 common shares by Ares Private Equity and Opportunistic Credit funds, with a 30-day option for 3,000,000 additional shares. The public offering price is $10.25 per share, with gross proceeds of $205 million to selling stockholders. The company is not selling shares and will not receive proceeds, but intends to repurchase 1,021,580 shares from underwriters at the offering price. After the offering, Ares will hold approximately 63.59% of outstanding shares, preserving controlled-company status. The filing is a routine secondary offering and concurrent share repurchase, not a special-situation event.
